verdict.rationale: This is routine Office Click-to-Run behavior. The signed OfficeClickToRun.exe service launches Integrator.exe from its standard path, writes its own virtualized ClickToRun registry keys, and holds a full-access handle on the child process it spawned. All of it runs as SYSTEM with a call trace entirely within the OfficeClickToRun.exe image and system DLLs, so there are no signs of injection or abuse.
